Anup Sharma @ Chandrabhushan Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 14
August, 2024

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:132450
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 25789 of 2024

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Anup Sharma @ Chandrabhushan Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Daya Shanker Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant in Court today is taken on record.
2. Heard Shri Pramod Kumar Pandey, Advocate holding brief of Shri Daya Shanker Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri R. N. Srivastava, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.

3. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.250 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Ghaziabad Kotwali, District Ghaziabad, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that however there was allegation that by playing fraud, applicant misappropriated Rs.60,000/- from the informant but now dispute between both the parties have been amicably settled outside the Court and applicant has returned the entire amount of Rs.60,000/- to the informant through demand draft.

Anup Sharma @ Chandrabhushan Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145996783/
1 5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that the copy of the demand draft has been annexed alongwith the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the instant bail application.

6. He further submits that applicant is having no criminal history and all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate Ist Class and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 02.06.2024.
7.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. however opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the arguments on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. Considering the fact that applicant has already returned the Rs.60,000/- to the informant through demand draft, which he alleged to have been misappropriated and he is having no criminal history and all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate Ist Class and he is in jail in the present matter since 02.06.2024, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant- Anup Sharma @ Chandrabhushan Kumar, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
12. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

13. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 14.8.2024 Zafar  Anup Sharma @ Chandrabhushan Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145996783/
